params.name: Loop
params.desc: see chapter 4.9.

params.name: LError
params.desc: if false, no errors will be generated.

params.name: ErrorS
params.desc: if true an output file will be generated. See chapter 4.12.

params.name: Log_Error
params.desc: if true an additional log file will be generated which contains the actual element and bunch settings, i.e. including the variation due to the errors for each run. Note that module errors are added to the module setting and not to the individual parameter settings. See chapter 4.12.

params.name: LExtend
params.desc: if true an already existing error output file will be extended rather than overwritten.

params.name: Suppress_output
params.desc: if true any generation of output other than the error file is suppressed.

params.name: FOM()
params.desc: specifies the output to be found in the error file. Valid keywords are listed in the description of the namelist SCAN in chapter 6.3.

params.name: Err_cutoff
params.desc: cut off for Gaussian distributed errors in units of sigma. Applies to all errors.

params.name: Err_Qbunch
params.desc: error of the bunch charge.

params.name: Err_Xoff
params.desc: error of the initial bunch position in x.

params.name: Err_Yoff
params.desc: error of the initial bunch position in y.

params.name: Err_Toff
params.desc: error of the initial bunch timing.

params.name: Err_Xrms
params.desc: error of the initial bunch size in x.

params.name: Err_Yrms
params.desc: error of the initial bunch size in y.

params.name: Err_XYrms
params.desc: error of the initial bunch size in x and y. The parameter Err_XYrms has priority over the parameters Err_Xrms and Err_Yrms.

params.name: Err_Zrms
params.desc: error of the initial bunch length.

params.name: Err_Trms
params.desc: error of the bunch emission time.

params.name: Err_A_xoff()
params.desc: error of the aperture offset in x.

params.name: Err_A_yoff()
params.desc: error of the aperture offset in y.

params.name: Err_A_xrot()

params.name: Err_A_yrot()
params.desc: error of the aperture rotation around the x-axis.

params.name: Err_A_zrot()
params.desc: error of the aperture rotation around the z-axis.

params.name: Err_C_xoff()

params.name: Err_C_yoff()
params.desc: error of the cavity offset in y.

params.name: Err_C_xrot()
params.desc: error of the cavity rotation around the y-axis.

params.name: Err_C_yrot()
params.desc: error of the cavity rotation around the x-axis.

params.name: Err_C_zrot()
params.desc: error of the cavity rotation around the z-axis.

params.name: Err_phi()
params.desc: error of the cavity phase.

params.name: Err_MaxE()
params.desc: error of the cavity gradient.

params.name: Err_S_xoff()
params.desc: error of the solenoid offset in x.

params.name: Err_S_yoff()
params.desc: error of the solenoid offset in y.

params.name: Err_S_xrot()
params.desc: error of the solenoid rotation around the y-axis.

params.name: Err_S_yrot()
params.desc: error of the solenoid rotation around the x-axis.

params.name: Err_MaxB()
params.desc: error of the solenoid strength.

params.name: Err_Q_xoff()

params.name: Err_Q_yoff()
params.desc: error of the quadrupole offset in y.

params.name: Err_Q_xrot()

params.desc: error of the quadrupole rotation around the x-axis.

params.name: Err_Q_zrot()

params.name: Err_Q_Grad()
params.desc: error of the quadrupole gradient.

params.name: Err_Q_K()

params.name: Err_D_yoff()
params.desc: error of the dipole offset in y.

params.name: Err_D_zoff()

params.name: Err_D_Strength()

params.name: Err_D_Radius()
